name: K Vintners Syrah The Beautiful 2017
text:
## K Vintners Syrah The Beautiful 2017

**The story.** K Vintners is the creation of Charles Smith, one of the great characters of American wine. In the 1990s he managed a rock band touring Europe, where he fell for wine. Back in Seattle he opened a small wine shop and met growers in the emerging region between the [Columbia Valley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbia_Valley_AVA) and the [Blue Mountains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blue_Mountains_%28Pacific_Northwest%29). In [Walla Walla](https://www.google.com/maps?q=K+Vintners,+Walla+Walla,+Washington,+USA&t=k) he met the Frenchman Christophe Baron, who inspired him and sold him grapes: Syrah from Baron's Cailloux Vineyard became the first K Vintners wine, in 1999. Starting with 330 cases in 2001, production has grown to about 15,000; Wine Enthusiast named Smith Winemaker of the Year in 2014 ([Vinoscout](https://www.vinoscout.de/en/products/k-the-beautiful-syrah)). His motto: "I make powerful wines with good balance, not overripe, but always with that certain something."

**The wine: The Beautiful.** The Beautiful is one of Smith's Walla Walla Syrahs. A German merchant describes violets, blackberries, black olives and even lychee, full-bodied and velvety, with a deep core of dark fruit, fine-grained tannins and a smoky finish "of unique beauty" ([Vinoscout](https://www.vinoscout.de/en/products/k-the-beautiful-syrah)).

**The vintage.** Jancis Robinson's vintage charts don't cover Washington.

**What the critics say for 2017.**
- I couldn't find a published critic's note for the 2017 The Beautiful on pages I could read, so I've left critics out rather than guess.
- **[CellarTracker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CellarTracker) community: 92.0** (from your CellarTracker list).

**How it's drinking now.** In October 2026 the wine is nine years old. Your CellarTracker list gives a window of 2024 to 2031. So it is in its drinking window: violets, blackberry, olive and smoke. Decant an hour ahead and serve at 16 to 17°C.

**Food.** Grilled lamb with herbs, duck breast, smoked pork shoulder, or a mushroom and olive stew.

**Value and where to buy.** The Beautiful isn't listed here, but BSW Liquor carries K Vintners The Creator red blend 2020 at $110, and Charles Smith Wines' Velvet Devil Merlot and Kung Fu Girl Riesling at $22.49.

**Curious details**
- **From rock band to winery.** Smith's route into wine ran through managing a rock band and a Seattle wine shop ([Vinoscout](https://www.vinoscout.de/en/products/k-the-beautiful-syrah)).

Sources:
- [Vinoscout, K Vintners The Beautiful Syrah](https://www.vinoscout.de/en/products/k-the-beautiful-syrah)
